name: token_conditioned_key_adapter_runner_amendment_2026-11-09
scope: Implementation clarification and integrity corrections before the efficacy run; no method, split, optimizer, schedule, metric, or release threshold changes.

runner.training_path: Use modeling.complementary_memory.training.reader_clip_loss for autoregressive post-prompt training. Each four-frame update consumes frozen image features, predicts each frame from the current memory bank, uses ground truth only for post-forward loss, and writes the arm's own predicted memory outputs.
runner.chunk_size: Four frames, parsed from the frozen protocol's schedule statement; fail closed if the statement changes.
runner.training_targets_and_updates: Derive target and update counts from the frozen train manifest sequences, first-labeled-frame prompt, and four-frame chunking. Store those counts in setup.json. Do not inspect test frame or mask records before the validation release decision.
runner.native_reference: Generate one fresh native SAM2 validation reference using the exact checkpoint, configuration, manifest frames, prompts, and propagation implementation in this run.
runner.validation: Evaluate the one fixed post-training checkpoint on the frozen seq13-seq15 validation split. Open test sequence frame/mask records only after the predeclared release screen passes.
runner.statistics: Report equal-sequence means, paired sequence bootstrap intervals, paired Wilcoxon tests with Holm correction, sequence win/tie/loss counts, and leave-one-sequence-out mean Dice deltas.

verified_schedule_counts.cross_check: Candidate counts recomputed from the frozen manifest match the completed MAVOS pilot's per-sequence training receipts.

integrity_corrections.issue: The prior engineering gate writes its full result to completion.json and its source identity to setup.json; it does not write results.json.
integrity_corrections.resolution: Validate the completion and setup receipts, all embedded protocol/checkpoint/manifest/revision identities, and matching hashes for shared implementation sources. Hash completion.json into the efficacy setup as the gate-result receipt.

integrity_corrections.issue: The initial cohort runner loaded test-split frame records before validation passed.
integrity_corrections.resolution: Load only dev records during training and validation. Load the declared test records after the validation release screen passes.

integrity_corrections.issue: Cached evaluation summaries were not fully recomputed from integrity-checked prediction masks and frame rows.
integrity_corrections.resolution: Recompute presence, false-alarm labels, per-frame segmentation/boundary metrics, propagation summaries, and sequence aggregates from the saved masks and source annotations before accepting a cache.

integrity_corrections.issue: The frozen analysis plan requires outlier sensitivity reporting.
integrity_corrections.resolution: Add leave-one-sequence-out mean Dice deltas to the machine-readable and Markdown summaries.

unchanged: Token-conditioned key residual candidate and capacity-matched global-gate control
SAM2 checkpoint, frozen weights, insertion point, and trainable parameter allowlist
One-pass four-frame autoregressive training schedule and optimizer
Validation-only release threshold and test-set lock
